raw_text:
Here’s the complete 12-week programme summary for your 29-year-old recreational climber with right subacromial impingement. All work stays pain-free and below shoulder height; no overhead loading. Structure includes upper-body strength (2 main sessions/week), optional accessory/prehab, progressive cardio (2x/week), hangboard/climbing prep (Weeks 7–12), mobility, Saturday finisher, and body-recomp nutrition.

Global guardrails
- Pain 0–2/10 acceptable during exercise; must resolve within 24 hours. If not, reduce ROM/load/volume by 20–40% or regress exercise.
- No overhead loading. Favor neutral/supinated grips; elbows tucked.
- Tempo: controlled 2–3 s eccentrics early; crisper concentrics later.
- Climbing stays easy and symptom-free; no dynamic moves or overhead reaches with right arm.

Weekly template
- Mon: Upper Session A
- Tue: Cardio A (Z2)
- Thu: Upper Session B (+ Hangboard from Week 7; or do Fri)
- Sat: Cardio B (Z2/mixed or ARC from Week 9) + Saturday Finisher (choose if recovery allows; see guidance)
- Optional: Short accessory/prehab once weekly (15–25 min)
- Mobility: 10–15 min on training days + 1 longer session weekly

Phases and goals
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation—scapular control, rotator cuff endurance, pain-free press/pull in horizontal/low angles.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength progression—unilateral control, slightly higher angles below shoulder height, heavier isometrics.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Intensification and peak for Week 12 trip—heavier horizontal press/pull, clusters, strength-endurance; taper in Week 12.

Upper-body strength sessions (headline menu; see weekly notes for sets/reps)
- Pressing (all neutral grip, below shoulder height): cable/machine chest press, DB flat or floor press, incline push-up variants, landmine 1-arm press to chest height only.
- Pulling: chest-supported/Seal/T-bar row (neutral), 1-arm cable rows with slight torso rotation, low-angle face pulls to chest, scapular depressions.
- Rotator cuff/scap: ER at side and 30–60° abduction, sidelying ER, ER/IR isometrics, serratus punches/reaches to 90° flexion, scapular pull-downs.
- Grip/forearm: towel holds, plate pinches, wrist flex/ext, pronation/supination, wrist roller.

Phase-by-phase weeks (sets/reps RPE included)

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4)
- Week 1
  - Session A: Cable chest press 3×12 RPE6; Half-kneeling landmine press (to chest height) 3×10/side; Chest-supported neutral row 3×12 (1 s pause); Scapular pull-down 3×10; Cuff work (ER variations) 3×12; Pallof press 3×12/side.
  - Session B: Incline push-up or DB floor press 3×10–12; 1-arm cable row 3×12/side (1–2 s hold); Landmine chest-supported press 3×12; Low face pull 3×12; Cuff (sidelying ER) 3×12 + bear-hug isometric 3×20–30 s; Forearm 2×12–15.
  - Optional accessory: light scap slides, farmer carries, soft tissue.
- Week 2: Add 1 set to first two compounds/session; add 2–3 s mid-range isometrics on rows; banded IR 2×15 if tolerated.
- Week 3: Progress loads to RPE7; most compounds 4×8–10; maintain cuff/scap volume.
- Week 4: Small consolidation—slightly heavier early, then reduce final session volume by ~30%.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8)
- Week 5
  - Session A: DB neutral flat press 4×8 RPE7–7.5; 1-arm chest-supported row 4×8/side (2 s hold); Landmine 1-arm press 4×6–8; Cable row 3×10; Cuff ER 3×10; light serratus reach 2×12.
  - Session B: TRX/rings push-up high 4×8–10; Seal row 4×8; Face pull 3×12; Landmine Meadows row 3×10/side; Grip 2–3 sets.
- Week 6: +2–5% load if RPE<8; add mid-range adduction isometric (fly position) 3×15–20 s; optional scapular pull-up isometric with elbows ~90° and feet supported 3×15–20 s.
- Week 7: Heavier 5×6–8 for presses/rows at RPE8; maintain cuff and core.
- Week 8: Deload 30–40% volume, keep intensity RPE7; emphasize isometrics and perfect tempo.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12) — Intensification and peak
- Week 9
  - Session A (heavy): DB neutral floor press top set 5 @ RPE8.5 → 3×5–6 back-offs; Chest-supported row 5×5–6 (2 s squeeze); Landmine 1-arm press clusters 4×(3+3)/side; Cable row heavy + drop; Cuff/serratus 3–4 sets.
  - Session B: Machine chest press or weighted incline push-up 4×5–6 @ RPE8–8.5; Seal/T-bar row 4×5–6; Face pull 3×10 (2 s hold); 1-arm landmine row 3×6–8; Grip isometrics.
- Week 10 (heaviest loads)
  - Session A: Floor press 2 top sets 4–5 @ RPE8.5–9 + 2 back-offs; Row 5×4–5 @ RPE8.5–9; Landmine press clusters 4×(2+2+2)/side; Cable row 3×5–6; Cuff.
  - Session B: Press 1 top set 4–5 @ RPE8.5–9 + 2 back-offs; Row 4×4–5; Face pull 3×8–10; Landmine row 3×6/side; Grip.
- Week 11 (overreach + density)
  - Session A: Floor press 4×5 @ RPE8–8.5; Row 4×5–6; Landmine clusters 3×(3+3)/side; Cable row AMRAP set (1–2 RIR); Cuff/serratus.
  - Session B: Press 4×6–8 @ RPE8 (last set near 1–2 RIR); Row 4×6–8; Face pull 3×10–12; Landmine row 3×8/side; Grip holds.
- Week 12 (taper for trip)
  - Session A (4–5 days pre-trip): Floor press 3×3–4 @ RPE8; Row 3×3–4 (2 s squeeze); Landmine press 2 clusters (2+2)/side @ RPE8; Light face pulls; Light cuff/serratus.
  - Session B (optional 2–3 days pre-trip): Press 2×3–4 @ RPE7–8; Row 2×3–4; light activation only.

Cardio (2x/week; long climbing days goal)
- Weeks 1–2: Z2 30–35 min x2 (incline walk/bike/stair). Finish one with 6–8 min forearm aerobic circuit.
- Weeks 3–4: Z2 40–45 min + Z2 35–40 min with 4×20 s pick-ups.
- Weeks 5–6: Session A tempo: 3×4 min @ RPE6–7 with Z2 recoveries (total 40–45 min); Session B Z2 40–45 min.
- Weeks 7–8: Tempo 4×4 min (total 45–50 min); Long Z2 45–55 min (+ optional easy traversing below shoulder height).
- Weeks 9–10: Long Z2 55–65 min; Mixed 5×3 min tempo (45–50 min).
- Weeks 11–12: Long Z2 65–75 min; Second session Z2 40–50 min with 6×20 s pick-ups (Week 12: 30–40 min easy only).

Hangboard and climbing-specific prep (Weeks 7–12; 2x/week)
- Rules: hands at/below shoulder height, elbows 80–120°, feet on box/assisted. RPE 5–7. Stop if shoulder discomfort.
- Weeks 7–8: Assisted repeaters on jug/20–25 mm edge 6×(7 s on/23 s off) × 3 rounds; edge familiarization 5×10 s; 2 min rice bucket.
- Weeks 9–10: Repeaters 7/23 × 6 × 3–4 rounds (slightly less assist); Low-angle lock-offs 3×10–15 s @ ~90° elbow flexion; Towel carries.
- Weeks 11–12: Repeaters progression (8/22 or smaller edge with same assist) × 3–4 rounds; 2–3 min jug density set 5 s on/5 s off; lock-offs 3×12–15 s (skip Week 12 if peaking soreness).
- Week 12 primer (3–4 days pre-trip): 2×6×5 s easy foot-assisted hangs + 2×10 s easy jug hangs.

Mobility (daily micro + weekly session)
- Pre-session micro (8–10 min): Quadruped thoracic rotation 2×6–8/side; Foam roller mid-back extensions; Scapular push-ups 2×8–10; Serratus reach 2×8–10; Banded ER 2×12–15; Low-angle pec stretch 2×20–30 s.
- Rotate blocks (2–3x/week): posterior cuff/pos. capsule, thoracic breathing/rotation, scapular upward rotation synergy, anterior shoulder tone reduction.
- Pre/post-climb quick routine and safety cues as provided earlier.

Saturday Finisher Day (20–35 min; rotate circuits)
- Circuit A: Sled push; Farmer carry; Chest-supported DB row; Bear crawl; Reverse lunge to step-up; Suitcase carry/side plank.
- Circuit B: Trap bar/KB deadlift; Landmine 1-arm press (chest height); Landmine or cable row; Backward sled drag; Low chest-height med-ball chest pass; Front-rack or bear-hug carry.
- Circuit C: Russian KB swings; Step-downs/lateral step-ups; Seal/T-bar row; Short bike sprint; Pallof press; Towel farmer carry.
- Progression: Weeks 1–4 two rounds (RPE 6–7); Weeks 5–8 three rounds (RPE 7–8); Weeks 9–11 three to four rounds; Week 12 skip or 1–2 easy rounds early week.

Optional accessory/prehab (1x/week, 15–25 min)
- Light cuff 2×15; Serratus reach 2×12; Band pull-aparts below shoulder height 2×15; Easy farmer carries 2×30 m; Soft-tissue (pec minor/lat/posterior cuff) 5–8 min.

Nutrition (body recomposition)
- Calories: average 10–15% below maintenance; training days at maintenance to slight deficit; rest days slightly lower.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day (aim ~2.0 g/kg). Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day. Carbs: fill remainder; time 30–60 g pre/post training.
- Supplements: creatine 3–5 g/day; collagen/gelatin 10–15 g + 50–100 mg vit C 30–60 min pre shoulder/finger work; omega-3 1–2 g EPA+DHA; vitamin D if needed.
- Tracking: BW 3–4x/week (AM); adjust −100–150 kcal/day if 2-week average plateaus; increase training-day carbs if recovery dips.

Climbing week (Week 12) taper and fueling
- Strength: low-volume heavy exposures early week, then rest.
- Cardio: one 30–40 min easy Z2; light hangboard primer once.
- Fuel: move to maintenance with higher carbs (3–6 g/kg on climb days); 30–60 g carbs/hour during long days after the first hour; electrolytes.
- Sleep 8+ hours; prioritize mobility/tissue care; avoid any overhead exposures.

Progression checkpoints to advance or regress
- Advance load 2–5% or add 1–2 reps when all sets are pain-free and RPE ≤7 in prior week.
- Regress: reduce ROM, switch to supported versions, or use isometrics for the pattern that’s symptomatic for 1–2 weeks.
- Criteria to consider overhead work (post-program, with clinician): pain ≤1/10 during/after; ER strength ≥80–90% of IR; stable scapular mechanics; able to perform 4×8 neutral-press symptom-free at target loads.

Outcome by Week 12
- Stronger horizontal press/pull, improved scapular and cuff capacity, robust aerobic base (65–75 min Z2), improved finger/forearm endurance with safe hangboard exposure, and a deloaded peak ready for long, steady climbing days—while fully respecting pain-free and no-overhead constraints.
